module: Editor window "Traffic Debug" (menu Window > Debug) to inspect and tune the gameplay_traffic traffic system. Two tabs: General (number of traffic and parking vehicles, global settings via gameplay_traffic.setTrafficVars: activeAmount, spawnValue, spawnDirBias, baseAggression, speedLimit, aiAware, enableRandomEvents; debugMode checkbox; disperse button) and Vehicles (per-vehicle data: general, road, respawn, pursuit, timers, role, action log, forced teleport). Enables gameplay_traffic.debugMode on open and turns it off when the editor is deactivated.
notes: The window draws nothing if the gameplay_traffic extension is not loaded.
The action log is fed by the onTrafficAction hook, with at most 100 entries kept per vehicle.
The settings are clamped before sending: spawnValue 0..3, spawnDirBias -1..1, baseAggression 0.1..2, speedLimit -1..100.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook: registers the 'Traffic Debug' window (400x600) and its menu entry Window > Debug.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor interface frame: draws the window, enables gameplay_traffic.debugMode on first display, reads gameplay_traffic.getTrafficData() and draws the current tab.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is closed: turns off gameplay_traffic.debugMode and forgets the traffic data.

onTrafficAction.desc: Traffic hook: adds a line to the log of vehicle `id`, with the received timestamp, the action and its data, displayed in the Vehicles tab.

data.desc: Associated data, displayed in parentheses if present.
